test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : OLM :: HEF : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : OLM :: HEF : %

Analysis of Options:

**Option 1) # = POP, % = EUC**

**For # (POP) to OLM : : **HEF to % (EUC)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/322f4337fb610adf6fe880602d5005c6ad64f0f17c3267706c8ff8ba6feb5b60.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e068a8a2d823acea638b5da40e27d19566d118dc5cb40d501898b1b4368596b.png] 

 

Since the pattern for POP to OLM (-1, -3, -3) is not the same as the pattern for HEF to EUC (-3, +16, -3), Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = RVP, % = EQZ**

**For # (RVP) to OLM : : ** HEF to % (EQZ)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7816acd3b025b345851c0374e17a1ab0af90f831421a7faaf4fa22fe70ec5ca.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06460ccf2da8d29fe7520699048b89011413654080deb25e8b72d2efaad3bbe6.png] 

**Option 3) # = RUI, % = ESA**

**For # (RUI) to OLM : : **HEF to % (ESA)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3bcd89b11a62dc75e689d38ee8a48a2d5b3e6ab48ec04e38b6fe4dd464fcb12.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d569240ccdaa67ab52787082f4068263bda167c86b82d2f346acbab9ac88f83b.png] 

 

**Option 4) # = ROP, % = EBC**

**For # (ROP) to OLM : : **HEF to % (EBC)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a94be06fc51cfca403cf9dddd53e6f675976a582a5902d6862925f50997d5102.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d1171d01ff8f4fffe1db20624cb7ec94da609fd9cb1745f13c495c9e68a56c7.png] 

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 4** where the pattern (-3, -3, -3) is consistent for both pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
